chunks: An inquirer asked for the affliction that is to come
ai.seo_question: Who is the questioner in Surah Al-Ma'arij and what did he ask about?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the impatience of the disbelievers who demand the immediate realization of divine retribution, often interpreted as a rhetorical challenge to God's timing. It serves as a prelude to the vivid description of the Day of Judgment, emphasizing that the punishment is inevitable and will descend upon them from the heavens in stages. This reflects the theological concept of 'Istidrāj' (gradual leading astray) where those who deny the truth are given respite until the moment of their reckoning.
